chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 09 (Official 2025 Model Examination)
subject: chemistry-10

questions.question: In Solvay's process, ammoniacal brine is formed by dissolving $NH_3$ and: (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Ammonia and sodium chloride dissolved in water form ammoniacal brine.

questions.question: Which of the following can behave as both a Brønsted acid and a Brønsted base? (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Water is amphoteric: it can donate $H^+$ to become $OH^-$ or accept $H^+$ to become $H_3O^+$.

questions.question: For the reaction $2A + B \rightleftharpoons 3C$, what is the correct $K_c$ expression? (Official 2025 Model)
Which gas is used with oxygen in torches for welding and cutting metals? (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Acetylene burns in oxygen to reach 3300°C for oxy-acetylene cutting.

questions.question: Identify the Arrhenius base among the following: (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: $NaOH$ dissociates in aqueous solution to yield hydroxide ions ($OH^-$).

questions.question: Halogenation of methane in diffused sunlight does NOT produce: (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Diffuse halogenation produces chloromethanes; carbon black forms from incomplete combustion or direct explosive sunlight.

questions.question: Proteins are essential for the biological formation of: (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Proteins are fundamental structural and enzymatic components of cellular protoplasm.

questions.question: Molar concentration in $\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ of a substance in solution is called: (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Active mass is molar concentration expressed in moles per cubic decimeter ($[\ ]$).

questions.question: The gaseous envelope surrounding Earth is named the: (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: The atmosphere is the entire blanket of gases held around Earth.

questions.question: Which of the following is an air pollutant? (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Nitrogen dioxide ($NO_2$) is a toxic pollutant emitted from vehicle exhausts.

questions.question: Which statement about water is correct? (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Water has a boiling point of 100°C at standard atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: Separation of minerals from gangue by physical methods is called: (Official 2025 Model)
questions.explanation: Concentration (dressing) removes gangue through gravity, froth flotation, or magnetic separation.
